create_qpsworker_job: create a QPS worker job for a given language with optional remote host and perf profiling
create_scenario_jobspec: create a job specification to run a QPS performance scenario with workers and optional BigQuery upload
create_scenarios: create job specs for performance test scenarios filtered by regex, category, and language
build_on_remote_hosts: build performance workers on remote hosts via SSH with optional local build support
run_collect_perf_profile_jobs: run perf profile collection jobs to generate flame graphs from QPS worker performance data
